svg.title: Corpus tiers: what the model reads
svg.desc: Six tiers from ontology and foundational biology through Asian materia medica, Asian alchemy, acupuncture, and structured open data used as biological ground truth. Live counts are shown in the Workbench corpus panel, not baked into this figure.
svg.text: Tiers are derived from the axioms, not collected by taste. The Western herbal tradition appears only as a labelled comparative control (≤ 3% of tokens).

g.text: TIER 0
Ontology — the structure of the domain
Taxon · DrugName(form×script) · Preparation · Process · Compound · Target · Formula · Role(君臣佐使) · Incompatibility · Tradition · EvidenceGrade
TIER 1
Foundational biology & chemistry — the substrate
Anatomy · physiology · biochemistry · pharmacology & ADME · toxicology · phytochemistry · natural-product chemistry · botany · analytical methods
TIER 2
Asian materia medica — the core
神農本草經 · 本草綱目 · 傷寒論 · 金匱要略 · 千金要方 · 太平惠民和劑局方 · 雷公炮炙論 · 海藥本草
Charaka · Suśruta · Bhāvaprakāśa · al-Qānūn · al-Ḥāwī · Dongui Bogam
Asian alchemy & esoteric pharmacy: 抱朴子 · 周易參同契 · rasaśāstra (bhasma, kharpara)
TIER 2 · SCIENCE
Ancient science, agriculture, botany, dietetics
天工開物 · 齊民要術 · 夢溪筆談 · 救荒本草 · 植物名實圖考 · 飲膳正要 · Vṛkṣāyurveda · Kitāb al-Nabāt
TIER 4
Acupuncture & the channel systems
黃帝內經 (素問/靈樞) · 難經 · 針灸甲乙經 · 針灸大成 · 銅人腧穴針灸圖經 · open-access acupuncture RCTs
TIER 5
Structured open data — ground truth against hallucination
Dr Duke's · PubChem · ChEMBL · KEGG · STRING · Gene Ontology · MeSH · POWO/WCVP · GBIF · NCBI Taxonomy

text.tspan: COMPARATIVE CONTROL (≤3% of tokens, labelled in the registry):
the Western herbal tradition — used only to test whether a finding is an artefact of any large botanical corpus.

svg.text: Live counts per tier, licence and language: Workbench → Corpus panel (generated from the registry at runtime, never baked into figures).
